select max(cxr.SCHEDULE_DATE) SCHEDULE_DATE, /*排程日期*/ max(cxr.CX_BATCH_NO) CX_BATCH_NO, /*成型批次号*/ ci.TIRE_RING_CODE BEAD_CODE, /*胎圈代码*/ max(ci.BEAD_CODE) STEEL_RING_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ max(ci.APEX_CODE) TRIANGLE_GLUE_CODE, /*三角胶代码*/ max(ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_CODE) GLUE_CODE, /*胶料代码*/ max(ci.HEXAGON_MOUTH_PLATE) MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, /*口型板代码*/ max(ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_DIMENSION) SPEC_SIZE, /*尺寸*/ 2 UNIT_CONSUME, /*单耗(胎圈长)*/ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN, /*对应成型一班的胎圈胶计划量=成型计划量*2 */ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS2_PLAN, /*对应成型二班的胎圈胶计划量*/ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS3_PLAN, /*对应成型三班的胎圈胶计划量*/ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS4_PLAN, /*对应成型次一班的胎圈胶计划量*/ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY*2),0) CX_CLASS5_PLAN, /*对应成型次二班的胎圈胶计划量*/ regexp_replace(listagg(cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE||'$'||cxr.EMBRYO_CODE||'$'||cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION,',') within group (order by cxr.CX_MACHINE_CODE,cxr.EMBRYO_CODE,cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION), '([^,]+)(,\1)+', '\1') as quotaKeys /*机台code$胎胚代码*/ from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and cxr.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by ci.TIRE_RING_CODE
mapper.insert: insert into T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT_LOG (ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BEAD_CODE, STEEL_RING_CODE, TRIANGLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_CODE, MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, SPEC_SIZE, MACHINE_ID, UNIT_CONSUME, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_FINISH_QTY, MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, MID_FINISH_RATE, MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, NEXT_MID_PLAN_QTY, NEXT_MID_FINISH_QTY, NEXT_MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, NEXT_MID_FINISH_RATE, NEXT_MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, NEXT_MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME,data_source,PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME) select ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BEAD_CODE, STEEL_RING_CODE, TRIANGLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_CODE, MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, SPEC_SIZE, MACHINE_ID, UNIT_CONSUME, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_FINISH_QTY, MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, MID_FINISH_RATE, MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, NEXT_MID_PLAN_QTY, NEXT_MID_FINISH_QTY, NEXT_MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, NEXT_MID_FINISH_RATE, NEXT_MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, NEXT_MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME,data_source,PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.delete: delete from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.update: update T_TQ_ASSIST_SCHEDULE set DEL_FLAG = '1', UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
mapper.insert: insert into T_TQ_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD (ID, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, STATUS, SCHEDULE_DATE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG) values (SEQ_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD.Nextval, #{cxBatchNo}, #{batchNo}, '0', to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd'), #{userName}, sysdate, '0')
mapper.select: select param_code, param_value from T_TQ_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT MAX(BATCH_NO) BATCH_NO FROM t_TQ_auto_schedule_record where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')

select ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BEAD_CODE, STEEL_RING_CODE, TRIANGLE_GLUE_CODE, GLUE_CODE, MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, SPEC_SIZE, MACHINE_ID, UNIT_CONSUME, STOCK_QTY, SUPPLY_TIME, nvl(MID_PLAN_QTY,0) MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_FINISH_QTY, MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, MID_FINISH_RATE, MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, nvl(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, 0) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_FINISH_RATE, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, nvl(DAY_PLAN_QTY,0) DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_FINISH_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_FINISH_RATE, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, nvl(NEXT_MID_PLAN_QTY,0) NEXT_MID_PLAN_QTY, NEXT_MID_FINISH_QTY, NEXT_MID_PRODUCE_ORDER, NEXT_MID_FINISH_RATE, NEXT_MID_SYS_ANALYSIS, NEXT_MID_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DATA_SOURCE, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME from t_tq_schedule_result r where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and DEL_FLAG = 0

select ci.TIRE_RING_CODE BEAD_CODE, /*胎圈代码*/ max(ci.BEAD_CODE) STEEL_RING_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ max(ci.APEX_CODE) TRIANGLE_GLUE_CODE, /*三角胶代码*/ max(ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_CODE) GLUE_CODE, /*胶料代码*/ max(ci.HEXAGON_MOUTH_PLATE) MOUTH_PLATE_CODE, /*口型板代码*/ max(ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_DIMENSION) SPEC_SIZE /*尺寸*/ from T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO ci where ci.Del_Flag = '0'
and PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
and ci.TIRE_RING_CODE in #{beadCode} group by ci.TIRE_RING_CODE

select cxr.EMBRYO_CODE || ',' ||ci.EMBRYO_CODE EMBRYO_CODE, /*成型排程胎胚代码，施工表的胎胚代码*/ cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION || ',' || ci.EMBRYO_VERSION as BOM_DATA_VERSION, /*成型排程胎胚版本，施工表的胎胚版本*/ ci.TIRE_RING_CODE, /*胎圈代码*/ ci.BEAD_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ ci.APEX_CODE, /*三角胶代码*/ ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_CODE, /*胎圈胶料代码*/ ci.HEXAGON_MOUTH_PLATE, /*胎圈口型板*/ ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_DIMENSION /*胎圈尺寸*/ from (select EMBRYO_CODE,BOM_DATA_VERSION from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT where DEL_FLAG = 0 and schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') group by EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION ) cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ left join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 where 1=1
and (ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0' or ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE is null)
select MATERIAL_CODE from T_TQ_ASSIST_SPEC where DEL_FLAG='0'
